attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9, cronie), created the opsadmin user and configured /etc/cron.allow to contain only root and opsadmin, restricting crontab scheduling to those two accounts. Verified an arbitrary user is blocked from crontab while root and opsadmin can create/list/remove crontabs. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and cron health, issued a native systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed (73bafeef... -> 328a10ff...), and re-verified crond is active and cron access control (cron.allow, opsadmin user, allow/deny behavior) survived the restart intact.
